If a source does not work
A short troubleshooting path, so the right people see the report.

1. Confirm the issue using the original host app of the extension — for example a Mihon-type source should be tested in the Mihon app.\n2. If the problem also happens there, it belongs to the repository that maintains the extension: open an issue at the repository\'s own URL.\n3. If it only happens in Kototoro, report it in the Kototoro project repository and include the source name, the extension version and what you tried.
